guideContent.strategyOverview: Mono-blue artifact stax + combo deck that exploits Urza's second ability: tap any artifact to add {U}. This turns stax pieces like Winter Orb and Static Orb into one-sided locks — tap them off before your untap step, untap everything normally, then they re-enable to lock opponents. While opponents struggle under resource denial, you assemble one of three independent infinite mana combos. With infinite mana, activate Urza's third ability repeatedly to exile and free-cast your entire library, then close the game with Aetherflux Reservoir or Blue Sun's Zenith. The Polymorph package provides a one-card win: sacrifice the Construct token to Polymorph, guaranteed to hit Tidespout Tyrant or Hullbreaker Horror (the only two creatures in the library), which loops free artifacts for infinite mana. Every artifact in the deck doubles as a Mox Sapphire with Urza on the battlefield, enabling explosive turns and fueling the Construct token's power.

winConditions.title: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
winConditions.description: Imprint Dramatic Reversal on Isochron Scepter. With 3+ artifacts in play (Urza makes every artifact tap for {U}), activate Scepter for {2}, cast Dramatic Reversal to untap all nonland permanents including Scepter. Net positive mana each loop. Infinite mana → activate Urza's {5} ability infinitely → exile and free-cast entire library → Aetherflux Reservoir or Blue Sun's Zenith to kill the table.

winConditions.title: Polymorph → Tidespout Tyrant / Hullbreaker Horror
winConditions.description: One-card combo. Cast Polymorph targeting Urza's Construct token. The library contains exactly 2 creatures: Tidespout Tyrant and Hullbreaker Horror. Either one enables infinite mana by looping two cheap artifacts — cast one, bounce the other, tap the first for {U} via Urza, recast the bounced one, repeat. Proteus Staff provides a second copy of the Polymorph effect.

winConditions.title: Basalt Monolith + Rings of Brighthearth
winConditions.description: Basalt Monolith's untap ability ({3}: Untap) is not a mana ability, so Rings can copy it for {2}. Tap Basalt for {C}{C}{C}, pay {3} to untap, pay {2} for Rings copy. Copy resolves first — untap and tap again for {C}{C}{C}. Original resolves. Net +1 {C} per loop. Infinite colorless mana feeds Urza's {5} activation to exile and free-cast the entire library.

winConditions.title: Aetherflux Reservoir Storm Kill
winConditions.description: After achieving infinite mana via any combo line, loop cheap artifacts through Tidespout Tyrant or Hullbreaker Horror bouncing. Each spell cast increases storm count, and Aetherflux Reservoir gains 1+2+3+...+N life. Exceed 50 life and activate: pay 50 life to deal 50 damage to each opponent.

winConditions.title: Blue Sun's Zenith Deck-Out
winConditions.description: With infinite mana, cast Blue Sun's Zenith targeting an opponent for X greater than their library size. They attempt to draw more cards than they have and lose. Blue Sun's Zenith shuffles back into your library after resolution, so find it again via Urza's ability and repeat for each remaining opponent.

synergies.title: Stax Parity Break
synergies.description: Tap Winter Orb or Static Orb with Urza for {U} at end of the opponent before you's turn. During your untap step, the Orb is tapped so its restriction doesn't apply — untap all your permanents. The Orb also untaps, re-enabling the lock for opponents. One-sided resource denial that also generates mana.

synergies.title: Narset + Windfall Lock
synergies.description: With Narset on the battlefield, cast Windfall. All players discard their hands and draw cards equal to the greatest number discarded — but Narset restricts opponents to drawing only 1 card. You draw a full hand; opponents are left with 1 card each. Devastating soft lock.

synergies.title: Extraplanar Lens + Snow-Covered Islands
synergies.description: Exile a Snow-Covered Island to Extraplanar Lens. All lands named 'Snow-Covered Island' now tap for double mana. Opponents run regular Islands, not Snow-Covered — they get no benefit. Asymmetric mana doubling across 20 basics.

synergies.title: Hullbreaker Horror + Sol Ring Loop
synergies.description: Cast Mishra's Bauble (0 mana), Hullbreaker bounces Sol Ring. Cast Sol Ring ({1}), Hullbreaker bounces Bauble. Tap Sol Ring for {C}{C}. Net +1 mana per loop. With any 0-cost artifact and a mana-positive rock, this generates infinite mana and infinite storm count.

synergies.title: Codex Shredder Mill Loop
synergies.description: During a Tidespout Tyrant infinite mana loop, bounce and recast Codex Shredder repeatedly. Each time it enters, cast another spell to bounce it back, then recast it and tap to mill an opponent 1 card. Repeat to mill all opponents' libraries.

synergies.title: Paradoxical Outcome Refuel
synergies.description: Tap all artifacts for {U} via Urza, then cast Paradoxical Outcome to bounce them back and draw a card per artifact returned. Replay the cheap artifacts to generate mana again. Massive card advantage burst that resets your board state for another combo attempt.

synergies.title: Mystic Forge + Sensei's Divining Top
synergies.description: Mystic Forge lets you play artifacts off the top of your library. Sensei's Divining Top lets you rearrange the top 3 and draw by tapping it (putting Top on top). With Urza, tap Top for {U}, draw a card, Top goes on top, cast Top from the top for {1} via Mystic Forge. Repeatable card draw engine for {1} per activation.

highlights.name: Winter Orb
highlights.reason: The deck's signature stax piece. Urza taps it for {U} before your untap, making it one-sided. Opponents untap only 1 land; you untap everything.

highlights.name: Isochron Scepter
highlights.reason: Imprint Dramatic Reversal for infinite mana with 3+ artifacts. The most compact combo line in the deck — both pieces are independently useful and tutorable.

highlights.name: Polymorph
highlights.reason: One-card combo. Target Urza's Construct token to guarantee Tidespout Tyrant or Hullbreaker Horror (the only creatures in the library). Either enables infinite mana loops with cheap artifacts.

highlights.name: Hullbreaker Horror
highlights.reason: Flash + uncounterable. Loops free artifacts with Sol Ring or Mana Vault for infinite mana. Safer Polymorph target than Tidespout Tyrant — can be cast at instant speed if drawn naturally.

highlights.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
highlights.reason: Storm finisher. Each spell cast during artifact loops gains escalating life (1+2+3+...). Exceed 50 life, pay 50 to deal 50 damage to each opponent. Works with any infinite mana + artifact loop.

highlights.name: Rhystic Study
highlights.reason: Draws cards whenever opponents cast spells without paying {1}. In a stax-heavy deck where opponents are mana-starved, they almost never pay the tax. Enormous card advantage engine.

highlights.name: Force of Will
highlights.reason: Free counterspell that protects your combo turn. Pitch a blue card to counter any spell at zero mana. Essential for the critical turn when you're tapped out from assembling a combo.

highlights.name: Narset, Parter of Veils
highlights.reason: Static ability limits opponents to 1 draw per turn. Paired with Windfall, opponents discard their hands and draw only 1. Also digs for combo pieces with her -2 ability.

highlights.name: Tezzeret the Seeker
highlights.reason: Planeswalker tutor that puts artifacts directly into play. -X fetches Isochron Scepter (X=2), Winter Orb (X=2), or Sol Ring (X=1). +1 untaps two artifacts for extra mana. Not a creature — safe for the Polymorph line.
